visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a charcoal grey long-sleeved shirt, sits at a light-colored wooden table in a brightly lit living room. She enthusiastically gestures with both hands towards a large, flat cardboard package while smiling at the camera. Behind her is a beige fabric sofa and a minimalist white shelf. (2) The camera moves to a closer shot of her hands as she begins assembling large brown cardboard sheets. She meticulously slides interlocking tabs into precision-cut slots, demonstrating the physical construction. The background environment remains consistent with soft indoor shadows and warm lighting. (3) She holds up a rectangular board featuring a high-quality print of the Mona Lisa. She smiles widely, showcasing the artwork's details to the viewer. Her facial expressions are animated, and the lighting highlights the texture of the printed board. (4) She carefully places the Mona Lisa board into the base of the partially assembled cardboard box. Her hands are the central focus as she adjusts the positioning to ensure a tight fit within the structure's interior. (5) A close-up shot focuses on her hands peeling away a translucent protective film from a thin, curved piece of material. The material underneath appears glossy and light-colored. The wooden table surface is visible in the foreground with a shallow depth of field. (6) She fits an ornate, golden-patterned plastic frame onto the front of the cardboard structure, completing the 3D 'painting' box. A ginger cat's head and tail appear briefly in the lower-left foreground, observing the new object. (7) A ginger cat fully enters the frame, jumping onto the table and crawling inside the cardboard house to sit in front of the Mona Lisa image. The woman watches from the side, leaning in with a happy, affectionate expression. (8) A fast-paced montage shows four different cats—two ginger, one tabby, and one tuxedo—sitting inside the completed Mona Lisa cat house at various times. Names like 'OLA', 'OLI', 'APA', and 'ULU' appear on screen. The woman is seen reacting with laughter. (9) The woman holds a small black device, repeatedly pressing a button to create a rapid clicking motion. She maintains a playful gaze at the camera while white slogan text overlays appear at the bottom of the frame against the indoor background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an upbeat, high-tempo electronic BGM featuring a strong rhythmic beat. A female voice speaks with high energy and an excited tone, introducing the product. The acoustic environment is clean with a faint indoor room tone. (2) A series of sharp, mechanical 'click' and 'snap' SFX are perfectly synced with the visual assembly of the cardboard tabs. These transient sounds have a tight spectral bandwidth. The female voice continues at a rapid speech rate with varied pitch contours. (3) The speaker says 'Mona Lisa' with a playful, elongated upward pitch. The music maintains its driving energy. Short, soft thudding sounds of cardboard hitting the wooden table are audible between phrases. (4) A distinctive 'crinkling' and 'tearing' rustle SFX occurs for several seconds, representing the peeling of plastic film. This sound dominates the mix, accompanied by a slight swell in the BGM volume. (5) As the gold frame is fitted, hard-plastic clinking sounds are heard. The vocal arousal level remains high, conveying satisfaction and humor. The transition between phases is marked by a subtle whoosh-like SFX. (6) A soft cat 'meow' is heard. The woman's voice shifts to a gentle, affectionate tone with lower volume and slower speech rate while talking to the pet. The BGM melody becomes more prominent. (7) A montage sequence features layered sounds of laughter and short, excited exclamations. The beat of the electronic track remains the anchor. The audio event density increases significantly during this reaction phase. (8) The outro features a rapid, repetitive mechanical clicking sound effect, mimicking a camera or rapid-fire button. The BGM fades out gradually, leaving only the percussive clicks and a final hard cut to silence.
